rules.label: Bounty runes
rules.cite: 7.29: bounty runes spawn at minute 0; 7.38: spawn interval increased from 3 to 4 minutes

rules.label: Water runes
rules.cite: 7.29: Water Runes spawn at both power rune locations only at minute 2 and 4

rules.label: Power rune
rules.cite: 7.29: starting at 6 minutes, Power Runes spawn as usual (every 2 minutes, unchanged through 7.41f)

rules.label: Wisdom shrines
rules.cite: 7.33: wisdom at 7:00 and every 7 minutes; 7.38: Shrines of Wisdom activate every 7 minutes

rules.label: Healing lotus
rules.cite: 7.33: every 3 minutes each Lotus Pool spawns 1 Healing Lotus, up to 6

rules.label: Tormentor
rules.cite: 7.39: first spawn time increased from 15:00 to 20:00; 7.33: respawns 10 minutes after defeat

rules.label: Neutral items
rules.cite: 7.38: Madstone cap rises at 15:00, 25:00, 35:00 and 60:00; 7.41: Tier 1 availability changed from 5:00 to 0:00

rules.label: Stack camps
rules.cite: Neutral camps respawn on every minute mark when their spawn box is empty; pull at about :53

rules.label: Extra siege creep
rules.cite: 7.41: first +1 siege creep timing 35:00 -> 30:00; second at 60:00

rules.label: Roshan
rules.cite: 7.38: Roshan's respawn takes between 8 to 11 minutes

rules.label: Aegis expires
rules.cite: Aegis of the Immortal disappears 5 minutes after pickup

rules.label: Day / night
rules.cite: Day and night alternate every 5 minutes; the live state comes from GSI map.daytime
